items.description: Implement Crossing rules, lanes, scoring, levels, controls, rendering and audio routing; keep every existing test passing.
items.verify: Run all tests; require nonempty Crossing engine and UI groups; fail on discovery errors and report skips. Cover each brief rule and transition.

items.description: Prove both outcomes are reachable with legal input only.
items.verify: Replay from a new game using only hops and elapsed time: one run wins level 3, one run loses all three lives.

items.description: Check the real Crossing terminal loop and cleanup.
items.verify: PTY drives hops, pause, restart, mute, resize while playing and paused, Q and SIGINT; compares trace states and restored terminal modes; retains a transcript.
Help succeeds without a terminal; tests cover flags and the nonterminal error.

items.description: Crossing appears in the arcade menu and passes the existing menu check on the macOS host.
items.verify: Jon or a Mac session runs python3 -B scripts/check_arcade.py and reports the result; the Linux sandbox baseline fails for all games on missing audio, so it cannot prove this.

items.description: Inspect Crossing presentation against the paper/jade style.
items.verify: Retain and inspect captures at 80x30 and 100x35, color and monochrome, covering play, pause, life lost, win and game over. Record concrete observations; not a playtest.

items.description: Document the game and the dogfood run for a fresh session.
items.verify: README matches approved rules and commands. Handoff and retro name evidence, tools, failures and recoveries, operator interventions, and remaining human play/listening uncertainty. No invented approval or feedback.
